title: Theodo — Software Engineer
disclaimer: This is a tailoring aid, not an ATS score: no single number represents how employers' systems rank resumes. 'Missing' means no supporting text was found in this PDF, not that you lack the skill.

findings.message: Experience from your dates: 10.8 years counting overlaps once, 10.8 years if a parser adds every job. Requirements like '3+ years' are filtered on numbers like these.
The PDF has no author field; set it to your name.
'mohamed amine sayagh resume | p# masayagh.com/hire' appears on every page (header/footer?). Usually harmless, but some parsers fold it into the surrounding section.
experience: 2 of 24 lines include a number or measurable result. Recruiters look for scale and outcomes (users, clients, %, time saved) where you truthfully have them.
experience: 4 lines start with 'Developed'; vary the verbs.

evidence_coverage.formula: (met + 0.5 × partial) ÷ requirements, per priority; uncertain and missing count 0
